items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: Everybody know where Nat Dahl lived?

ctx.x: Mmhmm. But uh, did you know him up in Donaldsonville or?

No, no. I met him, when I met him, he had came here from Chicago. But uh, he had, he hadn't been gone long when I came to New Orleans and that was around 1925. His wife was, his wife was still living around here. Right down there by that church. Everybody know where Nat Dahl lived? Right across the street. His wife was some kind of- Is that Liberty? Yeah. Richard M. Jones's wife was a singer, some kind of, some kind of classical singer, something like that. Do you know her name? No, I don't know, I don't know, I…
You don't remember her name. You must have known her a little bit. Richard M. Jones came back to New Orleans for, just for a visit. You mean?
